data.one_liner: Customizable image cropper widget for Flutter
data.what_it_does: Provides a widget that lets users crop images with rotation, scaling, and translation. It supports custom shapes, borders, and masks, and returns a cropped image as a MemoryImage.
use_when: You need a cropper with custom shapes or borders
You want to crop images locally without external services
You need fine control over crop area and image manipulation
avoid_when: You require advanced image editing features like filters or layers
strengths: Fully customizable crop area and border
weaknesses: No built‑in image filtering or advanced editing
Requires manual handling of image sources
data.setup_notes: Add dependency to pubspec and import package

alternatives.name: image
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides basic image manipulation and cropping capabilities

alternatives.name: flutter_svg
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need to crop SVG images instead of raster

alternatives.name: cached_network_image
alternatives.why_pick_it: If you need network image caching before cropping

data.minimal_example:
CustomImageCrop(
  cropController: controller,
  image: const AssetImage('assets/test.png'),
)
